_comments.oteracount.repo: Optional: path to an Oteracount checkout (with node_modules), e.g. C:/data/Otenization/Oteracount. Enables checks/oteracount.check.mjs — a real Login with Oteracount round trip against a PRIVATE Oteracount it starts on app.port + 2 with its own schema (oteracount_tmpl_test, dropped after). Your running Oteracount is never touched.
_comments.what: Copy to test.config.json (gitignored) to enable checks/database.check.mjs. Without it, DB checks are SKIPPED, not failed.
_comments.schema: Tests create and DROP the schema "<project>_test" (here my_app_test) — never your real schema. Use a non-superuser test account.
